[[File:CompForce_HR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A CompForce Assault trooper wearing heat reflective power armor]]
'''Heat reflective power armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by [[CompForce Assault trooper]]s. The armor was white and differed significantly in design from standard [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] armor designs used by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]]. The armor provided minor protection against energy weapons, and greater protection against physical attacks.
